note: The walker's pack of cloth pouches and the piles at camp (docs/future/13 sections 4.1 and 4.5). startPouches: pouches from the start; perCarrier: pouches each made carrier adds (satchel, basket, frame), so 6, 8, 10, 12; handfulsPerPouch: Gather taps that fill one pouch (one look step each). groups: the fixed sort order of pouches, never shown. partGroups: the group of a plant-part kind '<species>.<part>' that kinds does not list. kinds: one row per non-plant kind, in sort order within its group; sketch names its drawing, camp is the camp slot its pile prefers ('sticks', 'stones', 'clay', 'heap' for the first free heap slot), or where it goes instead ('rack' for herbs, 'bowl' for food, 'none' for worms, which dig themselves in, 'pouch' for seeds and clumps, which wait for a hole); a pile whose preferred slot is taken by another kind falls back to the first free heap slot. name: the pouch card's title; line: the card's one line. piles: handfuls a ground pile holds, the top of each look step (small, good, big), the rack's bunches and the handfuls a rack bunch or bowl holds. heaps: K-21 heaps left when the pack is full; cap is how many lie out at once, tapM their tap radius. pot: water classes the clay pot fills from, and whether it takes sea water. rill: when the hint about a rill to camp shows. ui: pouch tap target, gap and drawing size in px (Matt, October 22, 2026: 48 px targets). words: every line the pack, piles and pot say.
